system.description:
Bolstering Leadership. Your fearless bravery can be an inspiration to others. When an ally that can hear you and that you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against the frightened condition, you may immediately spend your reaction for them to reroll the saving throw. They must use the result of the second roll.

Form Ranks. With a shield and an ally by your side, you both can become unstoppable. You learn the Shield Wall combat maneuver and may activate it once per long rest without consuming exertion.

War Historian. You are well-versed in the history of the great generals who you seek to emulate, whether they are of the Brocken folk or not. You gain proficiency in History and have advantage on checks made to recall knowledge about legendary generals and great battles throughout time.

Languages. You may speak, read, write, and sign in Common and one of the following: Elvish, draconic, dwarvish, or goblin. If another language is commonly associated with great generals or warrior cultures in your setting, work with your Narrator to choose an appropriate language.
